name: axios npm package
rootCause: Socket has detected an active supply chain attack targeting version 1.14.1 of the core npm package, axios. The attacker injected malicious code into axios by introducing a malicious dependency that first appeared today. Developers using axios are advised to pin their versions immediately and review their project lockfiles.

descriptions.text: Socket has detected an active supply chain attack targeting version 1.14.1 of the core npm package, axios. The attacker injected malicious code into axios by introducing a malicious dependency that first appeared today. Developers using axios are advised to pin their versions immediately and review their project lockfiles.

Malicious versions of the Axios npm package published on March 31, 2026, incorporated a hidden dependency that installed a remote access trojan on developer systems. Attackers gained access to sensitive credentials, posing risks for cryptocurrency operations and CI/CD pipelines until discovery and rapid removal. A supply chain attack on the npm ecosystem enabled attackers to publish Axios package versions containing a malicious dependency (plain-crypto-js@4.2.1) that installed RAT malware. This was facilitated by compromised maintainer credentials following targeted social engineering and malware deployment.
